interpretation: Context-specific observational evidence about whether a named adverse outcome has occurred at different rates when an explicitly available action was executed versus deliberately not executed.

scientific_and_computational_basis.title: Learned helplessness at fifty: Insights from neuroscience
scientific_and_computational_basis.use: Supports the importance of action-outcome controllability while not supplying a software coefficient or a subjective perceived-control model.

scientific_and_computational_basis.title: Role of the medial prefrontal cortex in coping and resilience
scientific_and_computational_basis.use: Supports the neuroscience relevance of experienced control, but this ledger is not a model of medial-prefrontal firing or regulation.

scientific_and_computational_basis.title: A Bayesian formulation of behavioral control
scientific_and_computational_basis.use: Provides a computational treatment of beliefs about control. Cy implements only the simpler action-conditioned evidence substrate, not that full formulation.

scientific_and_computational_basis.title: Controllability governs the balance between Pavlovian and instrumental action selection
scientific_and_computational_basis.use: Motivates comparison of context-only and context-plus-action predictions. Cy does not implement their Bayesian model comparison, fitted parameters, or action arbitration.

trial_requirement: A trial exists only when a structured world record explicitly identifies an opportunity, the actions genuinely available, the chosen action, the action actually executed, execution status, timestamps and a resolved relevant outcome. Missing action data is not no-action evidence.

action_conditions.action: The named action was available and execution_status was EXECUTED with that action chosen.
action_conditions.no_action: The named action was available and was deliberately not executed, either because another available action was executed or chosen_action was NONE with execution_status NONE.

model.prior_classification: CONVENTIONAL STATISTICAL PRIOR; not an empirical psychological constant
model.avoidance_contingency: delta_control = P(O | NOT_ACTION:A, C) - P(O | A, C)

causal_limit: The estimates are observational. Cy's choices are not randomly assigned, so differences can be confounded by context, actor, opportunity and prior situation. Causal control is not established.
state_lifecycle: Complete post-installation opportunities and exact posterior updates persist in Soma state. No prose backfill, forgetting, decay, recency weighting or arbitrary time window is used.
public_boundary: Public output contains exact aggregate posteriors, counts, means, variances and contingency differences, but not opportunity IDs or source event IDs. Owner inspection contains the complete trace.
soma_boundary: The ledger is accessible in Soma state but does not alter Anxiety, Arousal, Anger, Rumination, action selection, prompts, generated prose or brain-region activation.
